LESSON: READING 8.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How would you locate a material in a library?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. prepare a questionnaire to collect information on the steps involved in library research and locating library resources Learners with manipulation

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. prepare a questionnaire to collect information on the steps involved in library research and locating library resources Learners with manipulation

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination is enhanced as the learner portrays the ability to use imagination as they prepare a

questionnaire to collect information on the steps involved in library research and locating library resources.

Values:
124

Unity is promoted as the learner fosters love when they work harmoniously in groups to discuss the library research

process.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills-Empathy: The learners foster empathy when they collaboratively note down the steps involved in the search for

information and present findings on a graphic organizer.

Suggested Learning Resources: Dictionaries, authentic materials such newspapers, recommended Text books, nline

materials, adapted digital devices with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand.

universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips.
